content: Forget all the others, you can't ever let that old Bai potter wade into the fight.

speaker: Liang Xun
content: Tianshi Bai...

raw: [name="Boatman"] If he calls a strike of lightning down, he'll have blasted straight over the Sui Regulator and the Ministry of Rites. We don't know where the Tianshi stand on this.

content: I thank you for your concern, Master Shen.

raw: [name="Boatman"] *Sigh*... I'm only a boatman, for all my concern is.

content: *Sigh*... I'm only a boatman, for all my concern is.

content: We all devoted out hearts to Yan, but a little foolishness here and there hardly needed to get away from us.

raw: [name="Liang Xun"] Such is the prudence of the ordinary man.

content: Such is the prudence of the ordinary man.

raw: [name="Boatman"] That's what I am. Aren't you too, Mr. Liang?
speaker: Boatman
content: That's what I am. Aren't you too, Mr. Liang?

raw: [name="Liang Xun"] The land is vast and wide, all things free. Under heaven's infinity, all are ordinary men.

raw: [name="Boatman"] *Sigh*... What do you hope for me to do?

content: *Sigh*... What do you hope for me to do?

raw: [name="Liang Xun"] I hope you'll protect the peace and safety of Shangshu, Master Shen. If any setbacks should happen in the end... I hope you'll leap in to pacify the dispute, before Miss Ning and the other five act.

content: I hope you'll protect the peace and safety of Shangshu, Master Shen. If any setbacks should happen in the end... I hope you'll leap in to pacify the dispute, before Miss Ning and the other five act.

content: There's the old saying. Ultimately, human affairs all depend on heaven's mandate.

speaker: Liang Xun
content: A shame.

raw: [name="Liang Xun"] This is the first adage I learned from Yan's court: 'Heaven's mandate lies in man.'
